column8: Wed 18 Nov: 3a standard clause and NUMBERS 0: twelve issuer pages read; the register's 0.15% equals the dearest fee on the shelf, so the test charges the worst real fee, not a convenient one.
Wed 18 Nov: store only: the cheap end of the shelf (VBIL 0.06% to SGOV 0.09%) for a Table 3 row 4 swap if WInS lists one; VBIL has no stress record; which fund is listed stays a student's check.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e and Table 3 row 4 notes: the fee does not say what a fund holds; fix the use column, since TBIL at 0.15% holds one 3-month bill, so dearest equals furthest from bills only for SHV, TFLO, USFR and SHY.
Wed 18 Nov: refresh of Q16-015 and Q2d-033: carry BIL's current 0.1352% with no waiver (SEC and unsubsidized yields equal) into Q16-015.
Wed 18 Nov: 3a: BIL trailed its index by 0.12-0.15 points a year over every window, so the 0.15% charge equals a plain bill fund's whole measured cost; say at or under 0.15, not under.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e limit: an FRN fund's gap ran above 0.15%; the $190-$476 is straight-line Keel arithmetic, not in NUMBERS, and NUMBERS 0's bill ETF of 0 to 3 months already excludes an FRN fund, so use it only as the reason to name holdings.
Wed 18 Nov: store only: the cheaper funds' measured gaps (0.05-0.09) sit well inside the 0.15% charge; short records.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e and Table 3 row 4 notes: what each index lets a fund hold; fix the use column, since a 0-3 month fund's bills do not mature inside a 2-3 week December wait; say its bills are three months or less, so its price barely moves over any wait.
Wed 18 Nov: 3a aside: the fee is a 28th of today's 13-week yield but 4.5 times 2014's bill (Q81-008), so it bites only in a zero era; Keel arithmetic, mixed dates.

Wed 18 Nov: Table 3 row 4: fees move both ways (SGOV 0.12% waived to 0.03%, 0.09% now); row 4's fee-rise trigger and its swap of a dearer waiting ETF already cover it, no change; 2023-24 steps secondary.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e sizing: $1,427 is NUMBERS 2's $2,604 less $1,177 and may be said so; the $95 per 0.01 point and the per-fund $856, $571 and $141 are straight-line, not in NUMBERS, until completion.ledger is run at 0.06, 0.09 and 0.1352; the range's waiting distributions pay the same fee and are not counted.

Wed 18 Nov: 3a standard clause: checked against NUMBERS 2 (paid at -0.13% before the fee, 0.28% net loss; 0.00% with the full 0.5% margin), so 0.15% is exactly what is covered when the margin is used and no fund read charges more.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e and SKELETON's short-term Treasury ETF wording: SGOV +1.58% against SHY -3.90% in 2022 shows the frozen name spans two kinds; SKELETON 3a's first use (or 3e) and Table 3's note should say once that it holds bills of three months or less, as NUMBERS 0 does; $1,950 is Keel arithmetic on one year.
Wed 18 Nov: weaker twin of row 13 (why bills, not notes), with mismatched end dates.

Wed 18 Nov: NUMBERS 0's student listing check: last year's list held both kinds under one heading, so the check asks for bills of three months or less at 0.15% or less, never the words short-term; repo file read, Keel never opens WInS.
Wed 18 Nov: 3e or 3a: through 2008 BIL returned +1.77% with no losing quarter, lowest +0.23% in Q4 when bills reached zero; primary 2009 filing.
Wed 18 Nov: false as worded: the zero eras are not the whole working life of BIL and SHV (2007, 2017-19 and 2022-26 paid well above zero); the true remainder, two 2007 launches, serves no part.
Wed 18 Nov: 3e: in March 2020 BIL took $8.66bn, second only to SPY, so the waiting fund is where frightened money goes; drop never from the use column (say in 2008 and 2020); SHV week secondary.

Wed 18 Nov: store only: less than a tenth of the yearly charge is unsupported; BIL's worst quarter on record, -0.03% (Q2 2015), is a fifth of one year's 0.15%; say March 2020's below-zero bills brought no losing quarter; extends Q2d-014.
Wed 18 Nov: same sponsor wording as BILS in Q81-022; add BIL's name to that row.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e honest limit beside risk-free: SGOV held 16.3% in bills due 6-13 June 2023; fix the date, since 31 May 2023 was the day the House passed the deal and one day before the Senate (1 June), not two business days.
Wed 18 Nov: money funds avoiding X-date bills is Q16-036's quoted finding; keep the contrast with row 21 as one clause there.
Wed 18 Nov: 3e sizing of row 21: about $8 per $50,000 at 1979's loss is Keel arithmetic on one episode; drop about a dollar a week, which says nothing, and say a longer delay costs more.
Wed 18 Nov: 2023 bill yields near the X-date extend Q16-036's 5.84% auction; the use column's holder got the higher yield holds only for a buyer during the standoff.
Wed 18 Nov: store only, pairs with row 18: BIL gained $235m in the week to 3 May 2023 while SHY lost $123m; one week's estimated flows.

Wed 18 Nov: 3e list of fund risks, extends Q3a-027 and Q26-014 to the waiting fund: reconcile 32.0% in the money fund against the 22.5% liability before use, and drop small, since a third of net assets is not small, though it sat in a Treasury money fund.
Wed 18 Nov: Table 3 row 4 notes: CLTL became TBLL with no other change, so a rename needs nothing from Laura.
Wed 18 Nov: Table 3 row 4 notes: an index, a name and an owner changed while TBIL still held a 3-month bill; excerpts only.

Wed 18 Nov: changes tables.md Table 3 row 4 note (the frozen name line): SHV lost Short Treasury from its name in Dec 2025, so the waiting fund is identified by holdings and fee, the frozen name kept as a kind; rename dates secondary.
Wed 18 Nov: a 2018 rename, trivial beside row 27.
Wed 18 Nov: Table 3 row 4 notes: TUZ's closure is secondary only; read PIMCO's notice before use, and SGOV is thousands of times TUZ's $51m, not hundreds.
Wed 18 Nov: Table 3 row 4's closure case: the SEC says a closing fund pays out its assets as cash; pairs with Q78-040.
Wed 18 Nov: store only: median spreads of 0.01-0.02% make each sale of the waiting fund cost a few dollars, outside the 0.15%.

Wed 18 Nov: changes NUMBERS 0's row Where waiting money sits (the lead's call): the fee's level can lose UNVERIFIED while the listing check stays the student's; say at or above BIL's 0.12-0.15 point drag, not above.

Wed 18 Nov: changes Table 3 row 4 (its fee-rise trigger): watch holdings of three months or less and the gap to its own index on the fund page, in points, not trails bills by 0.15%; fit the one page or put it in tables.md's row 4 notes.

Wed 18 Nov: changes SKELETON 3e's limits list (and 3a's first use of the short-term Treasury ETF): only the fund kind is large, so name the holdings once; every size here is Keel arithmetic on single episodes, not NUMBERS.
